name: API Tests - Postman

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  api-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout do projeto
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Instalar Postman CLI
        run: |
          curl -o- "https://dl-cli.pstmn.io/install/linux64.sh" | sh

      - name: Verificar versão do Postman CLI
        run: postman --version

      - name: Executar testes de API
        run: |
          postman collection run \
            "postman/collections/API Quality Engineering - DummyJSON.postman_collection.json" \
            -e "postman/environments/DummyJSON-DEV.postman_environment.json"
